response.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS disp_records FROM disp WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE type <> 'DISPONENT');

assumptions.assumption: Any disp.type value other than 'DISPONENT' counts as not 'DISPONENT', including values not listed in the documentation (OWNER, USER). disp.type is NOT NULL, so the <> comparison has no NULL edge case.
